title: Closing a Marlowe Rewards Membership: Desk Guidance
content:
Closing a Marlowe Rewards membership is the customer's own decision.

## The rule

- The agent records a membership closure request in status pending customer confirmation. The membership closes only when the customer personally confirms it.
- A membership is closed only on a membership closure request for that membership whose request status is confirmed.
- Before the customer confirms, the agent tells them that any positive points balance is forfeited, including pending points.

## Effects of closure

| Item | Effect of closure |
|---|---|
| Positive points balance, including pending points | Forfeited |
| Marlowe Rewards Notes already issued | Stay valid until their own expiry under Gift Cards & Store Credit |
| Returns refunded after closure | Post no points reversal |

## A suspended membership

A suspended membership cannot be closed at the customer's request. It stays under review.

## Request status and outcome

| Membership status | Closure request for that membership | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Pending customer confirmation | Not closed |
| Active | Confirmed by the customer | Closed |
| Suspended | Any | Not closed at the customer's request; stays under review |
